human_summary: On 7 August 2026, two passenger buses collided on the Dhaka–Sylhet highway in the Kashikapan area of Osmaninagar, Sylhet, Bangladesh. Reports indicate a Sylhet-bound Bengal Paribahan bus and a Dhaka-bound Unique Paribahan bus were involved. The collision was described as head-on, with a video circulating showing the Bengal bus losing control and hitting the Unique bus, which then fell into a roadside ditch [ev_8675a512af387063][ev_99685340cfb96e6d][ev_e7e4274f75924b4d]. Casualty figures conflict: Prothom Alo reports eight killed and at least 25 injured, while The Daily Star reports nine passengers of the Unique bus died and at least 24 injured [ev_a50c19158fca4347][ev_f4f6bf3ae3a5ae94]. The exact time also varies: around 7:00 am vs. 7:30 am [ev_8675a512af387063][ev_a50c19158fca4347]. Location precision is area-level, coordinates represent the Kashikapan area centroid. Witnesses claim the Bengal bus attempted to overtake a pickup, veering into oncoming traffic, though this remains an allegation [ev_e7e4274f75924b4d]. The incident was covered by two independent sources. No traffic effects or emergency response details were provided. Key uncertainties include exact casualty counts, precise time of the crash, and confirmation of the overtaking narrative.
